identity_marker: heavy Nicetown 100% Blackout Thermal curtains with silver metal grommets and a solid black thermal backing
continuity_anchors: in a brightly lit room with a pre-installed metal curtain rod mounted above a standard window frame
video_goal: Demonstrate the step-by-step installation of Nicetown 100% Blackout Thermal curtains to achieve a fully darkened room.
single_prompt: A Close-up shot shows hands pulling the heavy Nicetown 100% Blackout Thermal curtains with silver metal grommets and a solid black thermal backing out of clear plastic packaging, briefly exposing the brand label. The camera transitions to an Extreme close-up as hands flip the edge of the fabric over to reveal the distinct, solid black thermal backing layer. Pulling back to a Medium shot, hands reach up and unscrew the decorative finial from a metal curtain rod that is already mounted above a brightly lit window. In a Close-up, hands lift the curtain and push the first silver metal grommet onto the bare end of the curtain rod. From an Over-the-shoulder view, hands fold the heavy fabric back and forth in an accordion style, sliding the next three grommets onto the rod to create deep, even pleats. A Medium shot shows hands pushing the gathered bundle of grommets further down the rod toward the center of the window to make room for the rest of the panel. In a Close-up, hands position the final grommet on the outside of the wall bracket, trapping the fabric between the bracket and the rod's end to lock the outer edge in place. Remaining in a Close-up, hands twist the decorative finial back onto the threaded end of the curtain rod until it is completely tight. A Wide shot captures hands pulling and adjusting the folds of the heavy thermal fabric from top to bottom so they hang evenly across the left side of the window. Moving to a Medium shot, hands grab the leading edge of the curtain and pull it firmly across the bright glass toward the center. Finally, in a Wide shot from inside the room, hands pull the two curtain panels together in the middle, instantly blocking out the sunlight and plunging the room into total darkness.
